product.name: Solo Stove Pi Prime Propane Pizza Oven | Portable Outdoor Gas Pizza Oven | Cordierite Pizza Stone, Demi-Dome Heating, 13" Wide Opening, 304 Stainless Steel, Heats to 950°F, Cooks Pizza in 90 Seconds
features: FAST PREHEAT - With its efficient demi-dome design, the Solo Stove Pi Prime Pizza Oven preheats in just 15 minutes. Enjoy piping hot pizza in as little as 90 seconds and make every meal a delicious success at any gathering.

PIZZA ON THE GO - This outdoor pizza oven is compact and lightweight and is fueled by propane, making it the perfect cooking companion for outdoor kitchens and on-the-go adventures. Whip up a homemade pizza wherever you go without compromising on performance.

PRECISION TEMPERATURE CONTROL - The front-facing temperature control lets you easily adjust the flame and heat levels of this gas pizza oven with professional-grade precision. It evenly distributes heat, creating the perfect cooking conditions for restaurant-quality pizzas.

CRISPY CRUST - The Pi Prime Pizza Oven is crafted from durable 304 stainless steel, meaning this outdoor pizza oven was built to last. The cordierite pizza stone withstands high temperatures, spreads out heat, and releases steam for a crispy crust every time.

WIDE PANORAMIC OPENING - The Pi Prime Pizza Oven's wide-mouthed panoramic opening allows for easy monitoring and quick turns during baking, ensuring every pizza is cooked to perfection. Powered by propane and demi-dome heating technology, it reaches up to 900°F in just 15 minutes.
